liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): Review highlights the strong performance of Sugaree and the subsequent final jam sequence [4]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Garcia's second bridge break into the verse is highlighted as a key moment [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-05-03.141831.sony.ecm33p.moore.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 190 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1977-05-03.aud.glassberg.motb.0042.86241.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 193 min; rated 4.4/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: Headphone listening recreates the Palladium atmosphere effectively; Recording sounds excellent with no noticeable flaws while working; Stereo balcony recording features strong Phil bass, similar to soundboards of that era [6][8][11]
- **gd1977-05-03.aud.gorinsky.6710.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Recalls a previous show where band members circled, contrasting with later stage separation [5]
- Crowd was excited to hear Jack Straw, which had not been played for two and a half years [7]
- Jerry experienced a voice crack around two minutes twenty, then softened before shredding guitar [9]
- Garcia and Godchaux perform well, and Donna Jean is heard singing [14]
- Row Jimmy is outstanding, though the next night's show is considered better overall [10]
- Well-recorded audience tape is rare compared to common Betty Board recordings from May 1977 [11]
- This specific show is considered a hot one, unlike the mixed quality of other 1977 dates [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-05-03.141831.sony.ecm33p.moore.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Jerry Moore and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jerry Moore's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-33P mics > Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UD-XLII with dolby B) > PCM [1]. Also: Glassberg audience source supplies crowd noise and first few notes of Promised Land [1]
- **gd1977-05-03.aud.glassberg.motb.0042.86241.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert and D. McCabe; source: udience 1st Row Loge Sony ECM XXX > Sony TCD5 X> MAC Mics spaced 30ft. [2]. Also: Glassberg master cassettes run 2.6% slower than the Moore source used for patches; Moore source chosen for patches due to correct pitch and front row balcony position [2]
- **gd1977-05-03.aud.gorinsky.6710.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by G. Gorinsky and Ron Spear; source: AUD>MR>DAT>CDR > EAC (secure mode, test and copy) > SHN [3]
